question: Which of the following rights forbids employment of children below the age of 14 years in dangerous jobs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Right against Exploitation**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Right against Exploitation is the** fundamental right** that forbids the employment of children below 14 years of age in dangerous jobs.
